propositions: b690 enables req.config to influence Pass-1 model selection, but plan-review.yaml declares model_ladder rung 0 as 'trivial' (haiku), causing Pass-1 to downgrade from opus to haiku despite being the finding generator
The downgrade is undetectable in tests because the offline suite substitutes FunctionModel/FakeRunner, masking which model the live gate calls
Pass-1 moved from opus to sonnet on 2026-06-27 when _verifier_cfg landed and req.config was discarded; b690 makes that regression observable and allows a restoration
Changing model_ladder rung 0 from 'trivial' to 'frontier' restores Pass-1 to opus while keeping Pass-2 verify and Pass-4 coach on sonnet per the operator decision
The prerequisite finder bin packing sized for haiku (200k window) rather than opus (1M window) causes unnecessary context-limit escalations that burn tokens
